name: New Jersey 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club, after-school program or camp and learn by doing. Topics are science, arts, healthy living, outdoors, leadership and citizenship.
who_can_apply: Youth in grades K to 13. The Rutgers 4-H homepage says it serves everyone in grades K through 13.
pay_detail: Costs are not stated on the pages read. Ask your county 4-H office.
duration: Ongoing clubs and programs; camp is a week in summer
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs and programs run through the year.
how_to_apply: Use the Join 4-H form on the New Jersey 4-H site, or find your county 4-H office on the Rutgers 4-H page.
notes: Not a job. It is a youth group. The Rutgers homepage has a Join 4-H form and a link to the New Jersey 4-H Camp. The pages read did not give fees, so ask your county 4-H office.
